zdroj: Dysgu Cymraeg Canolradd (De), Uned 20, s. 251–266 (slovník zpráv s. 262–263)

karty.priklad: Pasiodd hi ei harholiad Canolradd.
karty.priklad_cs: She passed her Canolradd exam (arholiad → [h]arholiad after ei = her).
karty.mnemo: ar + holi (to question): in an exam you're questioned in a hall so cold your nose turns frostbitten blue.

extra.pozn: sefyll arholiad = to sit an exam (p. 251); arholwr = examiner (outside the coursebook); not in the Geirfa, only in the title of the unit; own example

karty.priklad: Ces i gyfweliad am y swydd ddoe.
karty.priklad_cs: I had an interview for the job yesterday (cyfweliad → [g]yfweliad as the object after ces i).
karty.mnemo: cyfweld (to interview) + -iad (the act): an interview held on ice skates in the middle of a frozen lake.

extra.pozn: Cyfweliad (40% o'r marciau) = the oral part of the exam (p. 265); not in the Geirfa; own example

sever.priklad: Ges i gyfweliad am y swydd ddoe.
sever.priklad_cs: I had an interview for the job yesterday (cyfweliad → [g]yfweliad as the object after ges i).
sever.pozn: north: ges i instead of ces i (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Yn ôl adroddiad newydd, mae diweithdra'n codi.
karty.priklad_cs: According to a new report, unemployment is rising.
karty.mnemo: adrodd (to recount, to report, L11) + -iad: a report read out over the chimes of a blue ice-cream van.

extra.pozn: diweithdra (L14), yn ôl = according to; news glossary, p. 262; own example

karty.priklad: Bu farw'r actor John Jones yn ei gartref.
karty.priklad_cs: The actor John Jones died at his home (marw → [f]arw after bu; cartref → [g]artref after ei = his).
karty.mnemo: bu = was (past of bod) + marw → farw: 'was dead', i.e. died.

extra.pozn: bu = past form of bod; fixed news form, colloquially fuodd e farw or farwodd e; sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Cafodd y tŷ ei adeiladu yn yr ugeinfed ganrif.
karty.priklad_cs: The house was built in the twentieth century (canrif → [g]anrif after the ordinal number, feminine).
karty.mnemo: can (hundred) + rhif (number): a hundred candles blazing on one birthday cake.

extra.pozn: ordinal numbers (L17) mutate a following feminine noun; canfed (L12); news glossary, p. 262; own example

karty.priklad: Dyma gyfle i chi ymarfer.
karty.priklad_cs: Here's a chance for you to practise (cyfle → [g]yfle after dyma).
karty.mnemo: A memory aid: cyf- + lle (place): a place for you – your chance to step onto the ice rink.

extra.pozn: siawns (L2) = chance, luck; sentence based on p. 251 (Dyma gyfle i chi weld…)

karty.priklad: Cyhoeddodd y cwmni bydd y ffatri'n cau.
karty.priklad_cs: The company announced that the factory will close.
karty.mnemo: cyhoedd (the public): to put out to the public.

extra.pozn: cyhoeddus (L16); cyhoeddiad = announcement, cyhoeddwr = publisher (outside the coursebook); news glossary, p. 262; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r cwmni wedi gwneud cynnig newydd i'r gweithwyr.
karty.priklad_cs: The company has made a new offer to the workers.
karty.mnemo: A CUNNING (CYNN-ig) offer: a salesman offering blue ice lollies in December.

extra.pozn: cynnig is also the verb to offer (doeddwn i ddim yn gallu cynnig hynny, p. 252); news glossary, p. 262; own example

karty.priklad: Sut byddwch chi'n datblygu eich Cymraeg ar ôl hyn?
karty.priklad_cs: How will you develop your Welsh after this?
karty.mnemo: dad- (un-) + plygu (to fold): to unfold – a plan develops.

extra.pozn: datblygiad = development (outside the coursebook); sentence from the interview questions, p. 266

karty.priklad: Cafodd degau o bobl eu hanafu.
karty.priklad_cs: Dozens of people were injured (pobl → [b]obl after o; anafu → [h]anafu after eu).
karty.mnemo: deg (ten) → degau = tens.

extra.pozn: plural only, gender not given; degau o + soft mutation; cannoedd = hundreds, miloedd = thousands; news glossary, p. 262; own example

karty.priklad: Mae newyddion yn dod i law am ddamwain ar yr M4.
karty.priklad_cs: News is coming in of an accident on the M4 (damwain → [dd]amwain after am).
karty.mnemo: dod (to come) + i law (to hand): the news comes to hand.

extra.pozn: llaw → law after i; sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Mae pobl leol yn galw am well trafnidiaeth.
karty.priklad_cs: Local people are calling for better transport (lleol → [l]eol after pobl; gwell → [w]ell after am).
karty.mnemo: galw (to call) + am (for).

extra.pozn: galw draw (L13); trafnidiaeth (L16); news glossary, p. 262; own example

karty.priklad: A'r tywydd i gloi...
karty.priklad_cs: And to finish, the weather... (cloi → [g]loi after i)
karty.mnemo: cloi (to lock): at the end the broadcast gets locked up.

extra.pozn: clo (L9), ar glo (L9); sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.cs: field (area of activity); field, open ground
karty.priklad: Mae Gareth a'i frawd yn gwneud yn dda iawn ym maes gymnasteg.
karty.priklad_cs: Gareth and his brother are doing very well in gymnastics (literally: in the field of gymnastics; brawd → [f]rawd after a'i = his).
karty.mnemo: MICE (MAES) scurrying across a frosty field.

extra.pozn: maes parcio = car park, maes awyr = airport; ym maes = in the field of; sentence based on p. 256

karty.priklad: Mae'n bosib bydd y gwynt yn beryglus i yrwyr ceir.
karty.priklad_cs: It's possible that the wind will be dangerous for car drivers (peryglus → [b]eryglus after yn; gyrwyr → [y]rwyr after i).
karty.mnemo: perygl (danger) + -us.

extra.pozn: perygl (L11); sentence based on a question on the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 264

karty.priklad: Ond y siom fwya oedd bod dim anifeiliaid yn y sioe.
karty.priklad_cs: But the biggest disappointment was that there were no animals in the show (mwya → [f]wya after the feminine siom).
karty.mnemo: What a SHAME (SIOM) – a mug of lukewarm tea.

extra.rod_pozn: more often feminine (the coursebook has y siom fwya, p. 253); dictionaries also give masculine
extra.pozn: siomi = to disappoint (outside the coursebook); no plural given; sentence from the e-mail on p. 253

karty.priklad: Ar y cyfan, roedd hi'n noson siomedig.
karty.priklad_cs: On the whole, it was a disappointing evening.
karty.mnemo: siom (disappointment) + -edig.

extra.pozn: ar y cyfan (L17); n- doesn't mutate after yn (yn noson); sentence from the e-mail on p. 253

karty.cs: to hit, to strike (a blow; of a storm)
karty.priklad: Mae storm wedi taro arfordir y gorllewin.
karty.priklad_cs: A storm has hit the west coast.
karty.mnemo: TA-RA! (TA-RO) – and the cymbal is struck.

extra.pozn: past tense trawodd; bwrw (L11) = to hit, colloquially more common; trawiad = blow, stroke (outside the coursebook); news glossary, p. 262; own example

karty.priklad: Dw i ddim yn teimlo eich bod chi wedi hysbysebu'r noson yn deg.
karty.priklad_cs: I don't feel that you advertised the evening fairly (teg → [d]eg after yn).
karty.mnemo: TEG ~ TAG: a fair game of tag.

extra.pozn: chwarae teg = fair play, fair enough; annheg = unfair (outside the coursebook); sentence from the e-mail on p. 254

karty.priklad: Bydd protestwyr yn achosi trafferth yn Aberheli.
karty.priklad_cs: Protestors will cause trouble in Aberheli.
karty.mnemo: TRAFFIC trouble (TRAFF-erth): a sea of red brake lights.

extra.pozn: the news glossary has only the plural trafferthion (p. 262); gender from outside the coursebook (the glossary doesn't give it); sentence based on a question on p. 255

karty.priklad: Newyddion tramor nesa...
karty.priklad_cs: Foreign news next...
karty.mnemo: tra- (across) + môr (sea): from across the sea.

extra.pozn: tra (across) + môr (sea); mynd dramor = to go abroad (the form dramor is fixed); sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Hoffwn i ymddiheuro am yr oedi.
karty.priklad_cs: I'd like to apologise for the delay.
karty.mnemo: 'UM, THE HERO (ym-DDI-HEUR-o) is sorry he's late.'

extra.pozn: ymddiheuro am = to apologise for (soft mutation after am); ymddiheuriad = apology (outside the coursebook); oedi (L11); news glossary, p. 262; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r ffordd ar gau yn dilyn damwain ddifrifol.
karty.priklad_cs: The road is closed following a serious accident (difrifol → [dd]ifrifol after the feminine damwain).
karty.mnemo: dilyn = to follow.

extra.pozn: dilyn = to follow; news glossary, p. 262; own example

karty.priklad: Yn ôl Iestyn, mae'n anodd iawn iddo gystadlu yn erbyn archfarchnad fawr.
karty.priklad_cs: According to Iestyn, it's very hard for him to compete against a big supermarket (cystadlu → [g]ystadlu after iddo; mawr → [f]awr after the feminine archfarchnad).
karty.mnemo: yn ôl = back; also 'according to': going back to what someone said.

extra.pozn: yn ôl also has other meanings: back (dod yn ôl), ago (dwy flynedd yn ôl); sentence from the article on p. 252

karty.priklad: Daw rhagor o newyddion yn ystod y dydd.
karty.priklad_cs: More news will come during the day.
karty.mnemo: ystod = range, span: during = within the span of.

extra.pozn: daw = will come (short future of dod); sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Dw i ddim yn disgwyl i chi ateb heddiw.
karty.priklad_cs: I don't expect you to answer today.
karty.mnemo: You EXPECT the DISK WILL (DIS-GWYL) load any second… and wait.

extra.pozn: Disgwylir = it is expected (impersonal form, p. 261); colloquially also disgwyl babi = to be expecting a baby; aros = to wait (for someone); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n gweithio i gwmni teledu.
karty.priklad_cs: She works for a television company (cwmni → [g]wmni after i).
karty.mnemo: COMPANY → CWMNI: a company that sells ice.

extra.pozn: cwmnïaeth = company (being with someone, outside the coursebook); news glossary, p. 263; own example

karty.priklad: Cafodd hi ei phenodi'n Weinidog Iechyd.
karty.priklad_cs: She was appointed Health Minister (penodi → [ph]enodi after ei = her; Gweinidog → [W]einidog after yn).
karty.mnemo: gweini (to serve): a minister serves – in a blue cassock, shovelling snow off the chapel steps.

extra.pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman; Prif Weinidog (L11); also a Nonconformist minister; news glossary, p. 263; own example

karty.priklad: Wyt ti'n mynd i bleidleisio yn yr etholiad?
karty.priklad_cs: Are you going to vote in the election? (pleidleisio → [b]leidleisio after i)
karty.mnemo: pleidlais (a vote) = plaid (party) + llais (voice): giving your voice to a party.

extra.pozn: pleidlais = vote (in an election, outside the coursebook); plaid (L12), etholiad (L7); news glossary, p. 263; own example

karty.priklad: Bydd y llywodraeth yn codi'r dreth ar alcohol.
karty.priklad_cs: The government will raise the tax on alcohol (treth → [d]reth after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: The taxman TREADS (TRETH) on your toes – and the bill arrives in red ink.

extra.pozn: trethdalwr = taxpayer (outside the coursebook); news glossary, p. 263; own example
